cases.scope: Publication litmus with two existing threads, one fresh node and no other happens-before edge. Models guaranteed initialization visibility from a release store read by an acquire load, plus consistent atomic accesses. Volatile control characterizes absence of a portable synchronization guarantee under these assumptions, not a native observed crash or a complete source race diagnosis. Other controls reject partial atomic/ordering repairs. Positive is an unimplemented release-acquire obligation. Excludes pointer tearing, alternate synchronization, same-thread signal semantics, retirement, multiple nodes, post-publication payload mutation, target code generation, lock-free implementation and complete C/C++ memory semantics.
